title: Palm Heroes 2 Deluxe
notes: On the exact IPA and POCO ARM64 build, the upright menu, adventure-map movement, a rendered tactical battle and unit movement were observed. The game's native save loaded after a fresh emulator process; after ending a turn with exhausted movement points, the loaded hero moved to an adjacent tile. This is not a complete playthrough: combat completion, audible sound, sustained stability, other maps and true widescreen remain unverified. The intro may be inverted.

testedOn.device: POCO X3 NFC M2007J20CG, Android 12, ARM64

reviewedUserReports.notes: ARM64 Release build on POCO X3 NFC (Android 12). Upright main menu; Single Player -> New Game -> Break reached adventure map. Tapping a road tile and horse moved the hero; enemy encounter opened tactical battle, and tapping a unit moved it on the grid. Emulator pause/resume returned to battle. Intro can be inverted. Battle completion, audio, saves, sustained play, other scenarios and widescreen were NOT verified. Partial, not full-game approval.
